description: NaAg(NO₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded to one N and six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaNO₆ pentagonal bipyramids. The Na-N bond length is 2.58 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.51 Å. Ag is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six O atoms. The Ag-N bond length is 2.20 Å. There are a spread of Ag-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ag and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ag, and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ag, and one N atom.
